name: FlipMenuCard
job: A menu-item card that flips like a cafe order slip to show ingredients, allergens and a tasting note on the back
visitor_action: click/tap or Enter to flip; flips back the same way
mobile: tap to flip, back side scrolls if long
motion: 3D card flip with slight overshoot and shadow shift (reduced-motion: crossfade between faces)
art_direction: Trattoria order slip as a real object: tomato-red gingham tablecloth, ivory paper slip with perforated top, hand-torn bottom, grease marks and a dog-eared corner, tipped-in taped polaroid, rubber-stamped item number, vinyl price sticker, handwritten name, red reverse side with taped chef's note
